product_metadata.title: NUTJAM Magnetic Bottle Openers, Classic Can Tapper, Portable Stainless Steel Small Beer Opener with Magnet for Camping, Traveling, Indoor, Outdoor (Black,1 Pack)
features: High quality magnet bottle opener –Magnetic bottle openers are made of stainless steel and plastic material, not easy to rust, not easy to deform, smooth sides and edges, durable enough for years of everyday use.
Feature design – Strong magnet,2 IN 1 design, one side is a bottle opener, the other is a can opener. Small and lightweight, easy to carry.
Ergonomic handle – The handle of beer punch Opener is made of plastic, non-slip, ergonomically designed, comfortable grip.
Storage - There is a strong magnet design on the back. You can stick it to refrigerator with the magnet under bottle opener tool handle.

Nice kitchen helper - Stainless steel bottle opener can easily and quickly open beer, cans, drinks, convenient for camping or travelling. Great for kitchen, college party, family reunion, backyard barbecue.
